For a block of mass $m = 5\text{ kg}$ on a horizontal floor, the normal force balances gravity:

$$N = mg = 5 \times 9.8 = 49\text{ N}$$

The maximum static friction force before slipping is:

$$f_{s,\text{max}} = \mu_s N = 0.4 \times 49 = 19.6\text{ N}$$

Therefore, the maximum horizontal force that can be applied before slipping is $19.6\text{ N}$.
